subject: Quick check on the due date
text: Hello Professor, I hope the week has been kind. I wanted to ask about the deadline because my notes say one date, while the message I forwarded from the organizing email seems to mention a later cutoff, and I do not want to guess wrong. The conflict involves caring for an older relative after work, and although the appointment is routine, it will likely run past the usual time. I do not want to leave you waiting for work that should already be on your desk by then, so I am asking now instead of after the moment has passed. A family commitment has come up that may take up a large part of the evening you mentioned, so if the date is still open or can be treated as a soft checkpoint, I can plan my time better. If it is firm, please tell me the latest moment I need to finish, and whether a partial submission is acceptable while the last piece is pending. I am happy to work around your schedule, but I would appreciate a clear answer so I can arrange the other obligation without creating a gap. If there is a document, syllabus, or calendar entry that explains the timing, sending that would also be enough. I will make sure the main deliverable is readable and honest about any unfinished items if a shorter deadline is in place. Thank you for your patience, and I am glad to keep working as soon as I understand the expected date.
